summary: What the machine plays reaches its sound card as the notes it was asked for, what the card records reaches a program whole, and the mixer's level outlasts a reboot

cases.behavior: the debug shell's scale on an Intel HDA controller reaches QEMU's recording as its five notes, fed by the controller's own interrupts

execution.cleanup: libetude-case ends the machine and removes its recording, which it keeps after a failure

steps.does: boot to the debug shell, run intrprobe, play the scale, run intrprobe again, and end the machine with QMP's quit
run wavcheck on the machine's recording

assertions.checks: intrprobe says INTRPROBE OK before the scale
audio test scale 2000 says Done. before the shell's prompt comes back
intrprobe says INTRPROBE OK after the scale
the count intrprobe reads on the audio controller's message vector in /proc/interrupts has grown across the scale
the console never says audio: stalled
wavcheck finds 262, 294, 330, 349 and 392 Hz in QEMU's recording, in that order, and no other tone

progress.means: a step of the manifest has ended
wavcheck has ended

native.reason: the case judges the recording QEMU's wav backend makes of what the machine played
